title: New new_area_seed_tiles key parsed with truncating jint instead of jint_strict
detail: jint silently truncates a decimal json.Float, while the loader's own newer keys (cap_fraction_permille, placement) use jint_strict citing the ODN-10 integer bar. A hand-edited "new_area_seed_tiles": 9.5 loads as 9 — silent, not fail-fast.
recommended_fix: Parse the new key with jint_strict like cap_fraction_permille/placement; on !ok reject naming growth_groups.new_area_seed_tiles, and add a decimal negative row to catalog_test.odin.

title: SEED-family annulus draw duplicated verbatim in both seed branches of growth_plan_demand
evidence:
core/growth.odin:694-702 (no-eligible-cluster branch):
				seed_attempt = true
				router_slot := growth_junction_slot_at(t, rng_range(rng, 0, i32(nj) - 1))
				dir := growth_dir_pick(rng)
				lo := GROWTH_OUT_MIN_TILES
				hi := span
				if lo > hi {
					lo = hi // degenerate span guard — the draw stays in [0, span]
				}
				dist := rng_range(rng, lo, hi)
				pos = t.node_pos[router_slot] + dir * dist

core/growth.odin:714-723 (coin-miss branch) is byte-identical:
			seed_attempt = true
			router_slot := growth_junction_slot_at(t, rng_range(rng, 0, i32(nj) - 1))
			dir := growth_dir_pick(rng)
			lo := GROWTH_OUT_MIN_TILES
			hi := span
			if lo > hi {
					lo = hi // degenerate span guard — the draw stays in [0, span]
			}
			dist := rng_range(rng, lo, hi)
			pos = t.node_pos[router_slot] + dir * dist
detail: Both SEED branches carry the identical 8-line draw sequence. Draw order/counts are replay-critical here — a future edit touching one copy can silently diverge the other family's stream.
recommended_fix: Extract a proc-local seed draw (junction pick + dir + dist in [GROWTH_OUT_MIN, span]) called from both branches, keeping the draw order byte-identical.

title: strict_spawn_class re-implements group_find/group_union union-find primitives
detail: The audit helper duplicates union-find find/union that already exist as group_find/group_union in package core; only the subset-scoped rebuild is genuinely new.
recommended_fix: Reuse group_find/group_union over a [dynamic]i32 parent — or comment that the independent re-implementation is a deliberate test oracle, preempting dedup churn.
